title: upgrade on an already-migrated estate re-emits its threads and withholds every v2 bucket file, so WP-02's ingest has no door on the fleet's real case
body:
**The v2 bucket ingest has no door on an estate that already has canon, which is every estate on this machine.** Measured by laksa-vc on Laksa at 59eeac618, 2026-09-13 10:49Z: `intent upgrade` exited 0 and carried none of the 184 bucket files. Its own lines: `already migrated: 113 thread(s) had committed canon and were re-emitted from it rather than converted -- their content is unchanged`, then `prune refused: the v2 tree stays, because the store does not hold every one of its files`, then 184 `withheld: <bucket file> -- <ID> carries no attachment <rel path>, so its content is on disk and nowhere else`. The files are the same 184 across 22 threads that `organize` refuses to prune (0318), and every one of them is left exactly where it was.

**WP-02 satisfied its rows on the conversion path and the fleet is not on it.** AC-02.1 reads _Migration ingests every bucket-only file ... as an attachment of its thread_, and `upgrade` on a thread with committed canon does not migrate: it re-emits, and the bucket walk that would carry the file runs only inside a conversion. AC-02.2 puts the prune for an already-migrated estate under `organize --apply` and has it refuse while content is unheld, which is exactly what fires: the prune waits for an ingest that nothing on this path performs. So the tool's own remedy (`run intent upgrade to ingest what the v2 tree still holds`) names a door that does not open for the estate it is shown to. Laksa, Lamplight and Courses 002 were all migrated at 3.0.0 with their buckets left beside the tree; Courses carried its seven by hand with `st attach`; Laksa has 184.

**Ruled under the pen, 2026-09-13, before the tag:** `upgrade` on an already-migrated estate runs AC-02.1's ingest over the bucket files of every thread it re-emits, the same per-file content probe, the same naming gate, the same preamble carry, reporting each file carried or withheld with its reason, so that the prune's precondition can be met on the path the fleet is on. One arm: a fixture with committed canon and a bucket carrying two files, upgraded, holds both as attachments of their thread with the probe passing per file, and the following `organize` preview reads 2 to prune (v2) and 0 refused. dc, since the ingest and the prune are WP-02's.
